parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the safe is made of steel, forming a thick, protective barrier that seals the opening of the safe.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main security barrier, locking and unlocking to allow or restrict access to the contents inside the safe.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinge axis to open or close the safe.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch, typically a dial or handle, is made of steel and mounted on the door of the safe.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to operate the locking mechanism, either by turning a combination dial or rotating a handle to engage or disengage the lock.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or turns to control the locking mechanism of the safe.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the safe is a solid steel enclosure forming the main structure of the safe.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the structural integrity and protection for the contents inside, resisting physical attacks and heat.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
